articles.title: Surgery by fairy lights and truckloads of fruit: the sanctuary saving Cameroon’s chimpanzees
articles.feed_excerpt: Poaching, trafficking, insurgencies and traditional medicine all threaten the central African primates, but a rehabilitation centre offers a haven in Cameroon Every morning in central Cameroon, the primatologist Sheri Speede wakes to a daunting task. At the Sanaga-Yong sanctuary, which she founded in 1999, there are 75 chimpanzees to feed four times a day and monitor for physical or behavioural issues. Of those, more than 30 need to be given routine birth-control medications, four are babies requiring round-the-clock care, and two are rowdy teenagers currently being integrated into new social groups. articles.title: Ten years, thousands of staff and a billion dollars: the exclusive inside story of Grand Theft Auto VI
articles.feed_excerpt: The latest instalment of the epic crime saga is finally here. We visit Rockstar Games for a hands-on encounter with the cultural event of the decade – and can confirm it more than lives up to the hype It still comes as a surprise for many to learn that Grand Theft Auto, the brazenly American crime series that has been one of the world’s most popular and most controversial video games for the past 20 years, is mainly made in Scotland. But if you grow up in Edinburgh, developer Rockstar North is part of the background mythology of the place. Plenty of people passed through this studio at some point or another in the 2000s, as game testers or employees. As a student in Edinburgh at that time, I would hear rumours of wild parties at the executives’ houses, as decadent as those in the game. At a bar or a birthday or a housewarming, you might meet a guy who claimed to have come up with one of the puerile puns that grace the in-game businesses (eg Nutsaki, a Japanese restaurant, or the fried-chicken chain Cluckin’ Bell). Grand Theft Auto is now made by a huge team of nearly 5,000 people around the world but its central nervous system is still in Holyrood, in the shadow of Arthur’s Seat. The setting of the latest Grand Theft Auto game really could not be further from the Scottish capital. Grand Theft Auto VI takes us to Vice City in the state of Leonida, a parody of Miami, Florida. articles.title: APEC工商領導人峰會將召開 大會將首次作倡議發布成果文件
articles.feed_excerpt: 今年亞太經合組織工商領導人峰會，將於本月17至18日在深圳前海國際會議中心舉行，國家主席習近平與11個APEC經濟體領導代表將出席，並發表演講、致辭或參與專題研討。習近平將於峰會開幕式發表主旨演講。 中國貿促會副會長李慶霜表示，其餘經濟體代表分別來自澳洲、加拿大、智利、中國香港、印尼、韓國、馬來西亞、墨西哥、俄羅斯、泰國和越南；2000多名政商界領袖將齊聚前海，共謀區域合作大計；115家世界500強企業代表將參與峰會，其中美國參會企業數量居外方經濟體之首，佔近兩成，目前各項籌備已經就緒。 李慶霜說，今次峰會以「共促繁榮 共贏未來」為主題，推動各方鞏固維護多邊貿易體制，攜手應對全球挑戰，峰會亦圍繞共建開放普惠的人工智能創新生態，探索亞太數字經濟合作新路徑，及粵港澳大灣區與亞太發展機遇等議題。 她指出，峰會將匯聚研討成果和交流共識，發布「2026年APEC工商領導人峰會深圳倡議」，是峰會創辦30年以來首次以倡議形式發布成果文件，系統地吸納整合工商界核心主張，面向領導人非正式會議建言獻策。 李慶霜形容，峰會是一場高規格的盛會，彰顯最高決策者對工商界的高度重視和厚望期許，同時聚集13個域外經濟體的知名企業，傳遞國際工商界對亞太板塊的信心。她又指，粵港澳大灣區聯通優勢，持續釋放強大合作引力，是亞太工商界關注對接中國市場的重要目的地，今年峰會落地深圳，設有大灣區專題研討，將進一步匯聚各方目光，放大灣區磁吸效應。 編輯：汪溟曦

selection.impact: 联合国推动2030年全球食物浪费减半，目标涉气候与民生，具广泛政策意义。
